question: What capacity retention did the 0.5 Ah NFA/graphite pouch cells show, and after how many cycles?
rendered: According to the document, the assembled pouch cells (0.5 Ah) were subjected to charge/discharge cycling at C/3 and exhibited a reasonable capacity retention of 72% even after 200 such cycles.
